senses.gloss:
m. (-दः)
1 Pain, anguish, vexation, torture, uneasiness, (either of body or mind.)
2 Sharp, shooting or pricking pain.
E.
तुद to tease^1 or torment, affix घञ्.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

n. (-नं)
1 A goad: see तोत्र.
2 Pain, affliction from disease, &c.
E.
तुद to give pain, affix ल्युट्.
